description: Search held regulation text. Returns pinpoints and excerpts, not summaries. Requires regulation id (e.g. eu-ai-act) and query string. limit, detail (compact|full) and max_chars bound the response. Then read_unit on the best pinpoints; verify_citation if checking someone else's cite.

as_of.description: Optional date YYYY-MM-DD: answer with the wording in force on that date (default today). Amended provisions say which act gave them their wording
as_of.title: As Of

detail.description: compact (default: ~400-char excerpt around the match) | full (whole unit text)
detail.title: Detail

kinds.description: Optional filter: recital, article, paragraph, annex, section
kinds.title: Kinds

limit.description: Most rows to return (default 10 on searches, max 50)
limit.title: Limit

max_chars.description: Cap on the response size in characters (default 8000)
max_chars.title: Max Chars

name: search_regulation
title: Search one regulation
